provenance: Offline synthetic benchmark governance documentation. No student identities or private data. Classifications record the provenance of the synthetic reference decisions; none of the cases constitutes an officially verified Pearson marking decision.

definitions.synthetic_unambiguous: The expected award follows from standard Edexcel 4MA1 marking conventions stated explicitly in the case derivation, with no documented contestable policy assumption. Still synthetic and subject to moderation; not an official verdict.
definitions.synthetic_provisional_rubric: The expected award depends on a documented synthetic policy assumption (e.g. ISW application, exact-pi acceptance, crossed-out-work credit, implied-method crediting, strict no-working zero, lowest-mark selection, or artificial M2 splitting). Reported separately; must not be presented as verified Pearson outcomes.
definitions.human_review_required: The case contains gold-null (unresolved) criteria that cannot be adjudicated from the synthetic transcription; requires teacher moderation before any accuracy claim.

algebra-invalid-method.assumption: Explicitly shown invalid working suppresses the numerically correct answer under this synthetic rubric

unreadable-final.assumption: Gold-null A1 criterion requires teacher transcription review

cylinder-volume-exact-form.assumption: Exact pi form accepted unless decimal/sig-fig commanded; not yet confirmed against 4MA1 scheme

probability-isw.assumption: ISW applied to post-hoc incorrect simplification pending strict 4MA1 scheme confirmation

mean-via-median-method.assumption: Explicitly shown invalid method suppresses numerically correct answer

quadratics-dependent-method.assumption: Deliberately strict zero for commanded-but-missing working; simulates strict enforcement, not a verified Pearson decision

expanding-partial-multi-mark.assumption: M2 block split into two M1 criteria for evaluator schema

geometry-area-crossed-out.assumption: Crossed-out work credited because no replacement was given

geometry-conflicting-methods.assumption: Lowest-mark rule applied because no answer line exists in the synthetic format

percentages-correct-no-working.assumption: Implied method mark credited for bare correct answer without mandated working

indices-correct-no-working-demanded.assumption: Strict zero for bare answer on explicitly commanded working question

speed-ambiguous-handwriting.assumption: Gold-null A1 criterion requires teacher digit review
